title: Interactive Code Suggestion Review with Follow-up Questions
body:
**Feature Request**
When Claude Code needs approval, I can either approve once, approve more generally, or tell it to stop. It would be great to have a feature like that found in CoPilot, where copilot will make a suggested change, and then I can ask follow-questions or request an explanation before accepting or denying it, then Claude Code and I could just jump right back into the flow. Claude Code's "yea-or-nay"  approach to performing actions makes a little harder to have some "dialogue" about the change before making a decision. I don't want to have to end a possibly-chained set of tool commands and then say "why did you want to do 'foo'?" or "let's do 'foo --bar' instead and then continue" ... or some such thing

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 0.2.29
- Feedback ID: 4ffdf636-ad02-4118-a4d2-d0e491c381d0
author: hesreallyhim
